description: This file defines the Leaderboard web page in the Online Examination System. It handles user session validation, retrieves user information from the database, and provides navigation functionality through button click events.

classes.name: Leaderboard
classes.description: Code-behind class for the Leaderboard.aspx Web Form, managing page load logic and button event handlers.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; checks user session, retrieves user semester info from the database, or redirects to login if not logged in.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the Dashboard page when the home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the User Profile page when the profile button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Placeholder for leaderboard button click event; currently does nothing.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by clearing session and redirects to login page.
